description: §7.6 rule (c): a server function's write of a file-scope `let`, made by a helper it calls, is E-FILE-SCOPE-LET-SERVER-WRITE (the web-program twin of tool/file-scope-let-write-exempt).
rationale: §7.6 rule (c): "A server function SHALL NOT write a file-scope `let`, **`E-FILE-SCOPE-LET-SERVER-WRITE`** … so does a write made by a function the server function calls, directly or transitively". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 open-Qs item 59 (c); the reading confirmed by ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted" item 4.
